page.layout: One page of text, single column in the centre; no margin notes. Running head at top centre. Page number at top right. Signature mark at foot below the last line.

main_text.p: dentibus ipsos aperte aduersari Scripturis, duorum alterum videre licet fieri ab eis qui praesunt dogmati: aut enim suorum dogmatum consequentiam, aut ipsam Prophetiam, vel potius suam ipsorum spem despiciunt. Semper enim sibi sumunt id, quod eis visum fuerit, esse euidentius quam quod dictum est à Domino per Prophetas, & ab Euangelio, & etiam Apostolorum testimonio comprobatum & confirmatum. &c. Ibidem.
main_text.head: XII.
main_text.p: Inani sapientiae opinione elati, perpetuo litigant, aperte oftendentes se magis curare vt videantur, quàm vt philosophentur. &c. Ibidem.
main_text.head: XIII.
main_text.p: Cum liceat ex ipsis Scripturis demonstrationes diuinis Scripturis conuenientes colligere, id omnino non faciunt, sed quod eorum voluptatibus suffragatur, eligunt. Gloriae autem tenentur desiderio, qui ea quae ex natura sua conueniunt sermonibus diuinitus inspiratis, tradita à beatis Apostolis & magistris, sua spōte fallaci sapientiae simulatione corrumpunt per alias tractationes, humanis doctrinis resistentes diuinae traditioni vt haeresim constituan. &c. Eadem libro.
main_text.head: XIV.
main_text.p: Circuit cauponas religio mendicans: exigitis mercedem pro solo templi, pro aditu sacri: non licet Deos [ritus Iesuiticos] nosse gra-
[illegible, ~3 letters] Iesuitas ... (this line is part of the text above; see notes)

page.notes: The last text line runs on at the foot of the page ("gra-") and is not a note; the foot paragraph above is an error and should be disregarded. Doubtful: "spōte" is printed as "spōte" (abbreviation for "spōte", i.e. sponte); "constituan." may be printed as "constituant", printed with an abbreviation mark. Printed "E 4" below the last line is a signature. The word "ritus" in the italic bracketed insertion may be read as "ritus" with uncertainty. Heading numerals XII, XIII, XIV are set as centred roman numerals in the body, level 2.
